evidence.section: Product Status — Affected Products and footnotes; Unaffected Products; November 5 changelog
evidence.statement: The revised advisory narrows bundled Node.js exposure to Enterprise 10.0 and lists 9.4 and 10.2+ as unaffected by that runtime issue. Universal Forwarder is unaffected. The separate Visual Exporter exposure spans Enterprise versions, with disable/remove as possible mitigation. Automation Broker, Observability Cloud and Splunk Observability OpenTelemetry Collector are listed affected; this advisory gives no exact fix for them. This supersedes prior applicability wording while preserving its historical dates.
